description: Sent to Charles Wickham Moore as 1959 New Year's greeting. Handwritten by GOK in black ink on verso: "Just to remind you of//Abiquiu and greet you//for Xmas and 59//Sorry you do not come.//I can't promise anything as//funny as Alans Story but//it is good here as you know//G."
imageCaption: Postcard from Georgia O'Keeffe to Charles Wickham Moore, c. 1959. Letters to Charles Wickham Moore. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. © Georgia O'Keeffe Museum.
